thread:
sam.sales: Quick sync — Brightline Systems sent back the RFP and they asked for a capability matrix + PO C schedule. attaching the docs they uploaded.
jess.se: Got it. can you drop the link? I want to check the latency/throughput asks vs our Dedicated profiles.
sam.sales: https://drive.redwood.example/brightline/rfp_2026_v2.pdf and matrix template at https://drive.redwood.example/brightline/matrix_template.xlsx
jess.se: skimmed — they want 99.9% p99 latency under 350ms for chat gen at 1rps sustained, and a reserved capacity quote for 4x A100s equivalent. that'll need a dedicated config.
nidhi.security: Heads-up — they also uploaded a 40+ page security questionnaire (vendor_sec_v2.docx). I peeked: encryption at rest, HSM/KMS, SOC2 evidence, and cross-region data residency. I'll need legal + infra input for some answers.
leo.pm: For the capability matrix, let's be explicit about fallback and routing policies. Brightline cares about graceful degradation to cheaper models during high load.
maria.account: Also pricing ask: they want committed monthly pricing and an overage rate. Do we have a standard proposal template for reserved capacity + canary deploy support?
jess.se: For POC timeline, propose: week 0 onboarding (access + test data), weeks 1-2 functional tests (latency/quality), week 3 load run (steady 1rps and spikes), week 4 wrap + handoff. Is that feasible?
sam.sales: Sounds fine. Customer said they want a masked test dataset for privacy — we need to confirm whether we can host in their VPC (private deployment) or run within Dedicated with strict logging.
nidhi.security: If they require VPC private deployment, we need to flag that as Private product — longer lead time and enterprise contract. Also: send them our SOC2 report and penetration test summary. I'll attach certs.
docbot: Attached: redwood_SOC2_type2_2025.pdf, infra_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf
jess.se: Action items:
- jess.se: fill capability matrix rows for latency, throughput, model variants, fallback policies. (Due EOD tomorrow)
- nidhi.security: draft security questionnaire answers for KMS/HSM, data residency, and logging. (Due +3 business days)
- leo.pm: propose a POC runbook + success criteria (throughput, p99, quality thresholds). (Due 48h)
- maria.account: prepare reserved capacity pricing + overage bands and contract term options. (Due 48h)
sam.sales: I'll send the client a proposed POC timeline and ask if they prefer Dedicated vs Private (they hinted Private). Also ask for masked sample dataset by EOD Friday.
jess.se: Quick matrix note — for fallback we should list: model family (gpt-3.8-like open), quantized variant, and Hosted fallback that trades latency for cost.
nidhi.security: One tricky Q in the questionnaire: "Can you support HSM-backed key generation in on-prem deployment?" We support KMS integration and HSM for Private — need infra confirmation on specific vendors (Thales, AWS CloudHSM). tagging infra.
sam.sales: tagging @leo.pm and @nidhi.security — do we want to offer a small paid pilot for Private to cover setup costs? they have procurement constraints.
maria.account: Yes, recommend a 1-month reserved + onboarding fee to cover infra provisioning. I'll draft numbers.
leo.pm: I'll sketch the pilot scope (minimum infra, SLOs, and rollback plan). Also include a canary model switch test.
jess.se: If anyone has short sample wording for the capability matrix cell "High availability / graceful degradation" drop it here. I'll paste into the shared sheet.
nidhi.security: sample: "Automated smart routing with policy-based fallback to lower-cost model variants; active KV/cache warmup to minimize cold start impact; dedicated pool failover with traffic draining and no-loss guarantee for in-flight sessions." feel free to shorten.
sam.sales: Customer replied: they prefer a Private deployment but asked whether we can supply an 'air-gapped' proof-of-concept. they want timeline and costs.
jess.se: Air-gapped POC is possible but expect +3–4 weeks for on-prem packaging and validation. call that out clearly in the matrix and SOW.
maria.account: ok drafting numbers — ping me if you need a rapid check. I'll put a line item for on-prem packaging and HSM licensing.
leo.pm: I'll produce a short runbook and a success criteria doc (will link to the sheet) and include test commands for throughput/load.
jess.se: sample load command to include in runbook:
```
# k6 script example
k6 run --vus 10 --duration 5m chat_load_test.js --env BASE_URL=https://staging.redwood
```
sam.sales: perfect. I'll consolidate and send to Brightline by tomorrow noon PST. anyone object?
nidhi.security: no objections. I'll get the certs and start on the questionnaire.
jess.se: thanks everyone — uploading updated matrix after I fill latency/HA rows.
sam.sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
